messages.content: 有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？

message.content: 截至目前（2023 年底），全球票房收入最高的电影是《阿凡達》（Avatar，2009）。該片由詹姆斯·卡梅隆執導，全球總票房約為 29 億 2 千萬美元（約 2.92 億美元），在多次重映後保持了這一紀錄。此前，《鐵達尼號》曾長期佔據榜首，但最終被《阿凡達》超越。
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？" which means "What is the highest-grossing movie ever?" They want the highest grossing film worldwide. That would be "Avatar" (2009) or "Avengers: Endgame"? Actually as of 2023, "Avatar" remains the highest worldwide grossing film at about $2.92B. But we need to confirm. We can use the function to search movies with criteria? The function signature: movies_search(title, year, genre?). It returns something. But we don't have a function to get box office data. The function only searches movies based on title, year, genre. Not relevant.

We might answer manually: "Avatar" (2009). Provide details: directed by James Cameron, released 2009, worldwide gross ~ $2.923B. Or mention "Avengers: Endgame" (2019) had $2.798B but was surpassed by Avatar after re-release. So answer: "Avatar".

But maybe they want the highest grossing film worldwide historically. According to Wikipedia, "Avatar" holds the record. So answer accordingly. Also mention that "Titanic" previously held the record until Avatar surpassed it. Provide context.

Thus answer: "Avatar".
